hypothesis: 98-byte IQ3_XXS blocks force 16-bit loads; a structure-of-arrays repack (aligned qs plane, separate signs/scales plane) lets the kernel use 16-byte loads and raises expert MMVQ throughput at least 1.5x with bit-identical dequant, giving >=10% decode on the route.
changed_variable: On-device byte layout of IQ3_XXS expert blocks and the matching load code; quantized values unchanged

baseline.engine_revision: AoS IQ3_XXS gate/up MMVQ (Strata 0.1.40.3 load path), 256 GRF; scripts/tmp/rq25_soa_20261011 bench binaries: aos128 offline-build/rq25_bench (default 128 GRF), aos256/soa256 isa-devimg-r3/rq25_bench_g256 (-cl-intel-256-GRF-per-thread, 0 spills, ISA in isa/r3/); sources src/tu_current.dp.cpp (Strata 0.1.40.3 Multi<18> load path) and src/tu_soa.dp.cpp
baseline.model_revision: real IQ3_XXS gate/up expert slots from the Flash-Next pack (layers 35,36,41,44,45,47; 427 slots x 1280 rows x 980 B, 512 MiB ring > L2), ring-20261011/ring_manifest.json

candidate.engine_revision: SoA IQ3_XXS gate/up MMVQ (16-byte-aligned q plane, separate signs/scales and fp16 d planes, same values), 256 GRF; scripts/tmp/rq25_soa_20261011 bench binaries: aos128 offline-build/rq25_bench (default 128 GRF), aos256/soa256 isa-devimg-r3/rq25_bench_g256 (-cl-intel-256-GRF-per-thread, 0 spills, ISA in isa/r3/); sources src/tu_current.dp.cpp (Strata 0.1.40.3 Multi<18> load path) and src/tu_soa.dp.cpp
candidate.model_revision: real IQ3_XXS gate/up expert slots from the Flash-Next pack (layers 35,36,41,44,45,47; 427 slots x 1280 rows x 980 B, 512 MiB ring > L2), ring-20261011/ring_manifest.json

workload.cells: per E in 1..6 (columns/tokens): one discarded warmup per arm, then 3 interleaved triples (aos128, aos256, soa256), each a fresh ring slice; groups 128, seed 25
workload.pairs: pair = (E, triple); primary comparison soa256 vs aos256 isolates the layout; aos128 incumbent reported in checks/grf_diagnostic.json and never credited to the layout
workload.correctness: dequantized words bitwise equal across layouts on both executables (word_mismatches == 0), f64 dot gate <= 5e-3 relative (cpu_check --gate-dots); bitwise-vs-CPU is not a gate on this hardware (RL-145 finding)

config.card: GPU1 only, PCI 0000:0f:00.0 / renderD129, ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:1 plus the binary's positive PCI match
config.vram: each cell allocates <= live visible_avail - 4 GiB (debugfs vram_mm)
config.host: idle host: no Strata/vLLM/llama container, MemAvailable >= 30000 MiB at preflight (RL-160)
config.power: as-found caps recorded and never changed; sustained thermal regime
config.guard: scripts/tmp/gpu_guard_20261011.sh before and after every cell

comparison.unit: GB/s of logical IQ3_XXS expert bytes per kernel second

evidence_rationale: RQ-25 isolated stage. ISA round 3 (research/2026/b70-run3-agent-reports-20261011/rq25-isa-round3.md): SoA keeps 16-byte q-plane loads with zero spills at 256 GRF; the AoS incumbent also reaches zero spills at 256 GRF, so the GRF mode is held fixed in the primary pairs. Gate >= 1.5x (min_relative_gain 0.5) as registered.
